Name: Production Progress - Crops and Machines
Author: aaaa2521
Description:
[size=5][b]Production Progress - Crops and Machines[/b][/size]

See crop growth, machine production, tapping and cask aging in one Progress tab in your existing game menu. Check each batch's progress and expected finish date, with a time of day for machines that process by the minute.

[b]Testing notice — feedback welcome[/b]
This is an early public release with limited in-game testing. It has not undergone broad testing across different saves, large farms or mod combinations. If something looks wrong or does not work as expected, please report it or join the discussion. Steps to reproduce, screenshots and a SMAPI log link are welcome and help us investigate.

[b]What's new in 0.1.16[/b]
Adds optional compatibility for the lazy menu page replacement behavior in Ultra Smooth 2.5.0; Ultra Smooth is not required. Fixes LT/RT tab skipping, clips partially visible rows inside the menu border, and leaves unknown historical completion dates blank. Matching production due on the same day now groups across locations and shows the earliest batch rather than an average, with quantities such as 80/500 when only part of the group finishes next. Regrowing crops display Growing. Letters cover the Progress icon naturally instead of making it disappear. Incubators are excluded from machine progress; real processing such as truffle oil remains supported. Detailed warnings identify menu failures and exceptions; routine crop maturity and successful processing are not logged.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]A wheat-icon tab between Skills and Social. Use your normal game-menu controls; no extra hotkey is required.[/*]
[*]Progress bars for crops and regrowth, processing machines such as kegs, oil makers and fish smokers, tappers, and casks.[/*]
[*]Matching products, quality stages, work states and completion days group across locations. Staggered machines show the earliest batch and its share of the daily total; progress is not averaged.[/*]
[*]Dates use the game's seasons and calendar. Minute-based machines also show a finish time. Crop dates assume that normal growth conditions continue.[/*]
[*]Completed rows keep their recorded completion date and show 100%. Casks display progress toward the next quality level.[/*]
[*]Native menu textures, a scrollable list with arrows and a draggable thumb, and hover text for shortened item names.[/*]
[*]English and Simplified Chinese in one download, following your game language.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
1. Install SMAPI for your game version.
2. Extract the ProductionProgress folder from the ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI and open the normal game menu.
4. Select the wheat-icon Progress tab.

To update, close the game and replace the existing ProductionProgress folder with the new one. Keep only one installed copy.

[b]Compatibility and testing[/b]
Version 0.1.9 was tested by the author on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6.8 and SMAPI 4.0.8. Version 0.1.16 is a regular release built against the same target, with 80 core tests and 134 simulated menu-flow checks passed. Its latest changes have not yet completed a new in-game test round. Ultra Smooth 2.5.0 was inspected statically; its menu compatibility was checked in simulations, not in the reporter's full mod setup. Newer game/SMAPI versions and macOS/Linux are not broadly verified. SMAPI is required; Ultra Smooth, Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Menu are not required.

Host and client synchronization is implemented for multiplayer, but multiplayer and split-screen have not been verified in-game. Both host and clients need this mod installed to use its multiplayer view.

The menu uses the game's current UI textures. Recolors of the same native textures can carry through to the progress bars and scrolling controls. Mods that replace the entire game menu or change its layout may require additional compatibility work.

[b]A few details[/b]
[list]
[*]The number beside an item is the number of tracked plants or machines in that batch, not the number of items you will harvest.[/*]
[*]Wine processing uses the game's minute-based machine timer, so it may finish during the afternoon. Crop growth and other daily cycles show a date without an invented time of day.[/*]
[*]If this mod first encounters a machine halfway through an unknown production cycle, a percentage may be unavailable until it observes a new cycle.[/*]
[*]Completed items without a reliable historical completion record leave the date blank; their completed status and 100% remain visible.[/*]
[*]The mod observes production state. It does not speed up crops or machines, auto-harvest, or change their outputs.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known limitations[/b]
Heavy tappers already processing when this mod is first installed have been reported missing from In progress; this remains under investigation. With a dark menu background, the Progress icon may appear darker than neighboring tabs while a letter is open. Full menu replacements may still need dedicated support.

[b]Source and feedback[/b]
Source: [url=https://github.com/shy-ci/ProductionProgress]GitHub[/url]
For a bug report, include your game and SMAPI versions, your mod version, a screenshot if relevant, and a SMAPI log link. Please mention other mods that change menus or machine processing.

[b]Development disclosure[/b]
Code, translations and this description were generated with AI following the author's design and feedback. The author performed in-game testing. The mod does not call AI services while running. Release screenshots are actual game captures.

[size=5][b]简体中文[/b][/size]

在原有游戏菜单中增加“进度”页签，集中查看作物生长、机器加工、树液采集和酒窖陈酿。每个批次展示进度与预计完成日期，按分钟加工的机器另外显示完成时刻。

[b]测试说明：欢迎反馈与讨论[/b]
这是早期公开版本，目前只完成有限环境下的游戏内测试，尚未经过不同存档、大型农场和各种 mod 组合的大范围测试。如果出现显示异常、功能问题或兼容性问题，欢迎在评论区反馈和讨论。提供复现步骤、截图及 SMAPI 日志链接，可以帮助定位问题。

[b]0.1.16 更新内容[/b]
增加对 Ultra Smooth 2.5.0 菜单延迟加载行为的可选兼容，不要求安装 Ultra Smooth。修正 LT/RT 跳页、列表边缘裁剪和未知历史完成日期显示；同一天完成的匹配生产跨地点合并，显示最早批次的真实进度，不取平均，部分先完成时显示 80/500 等数量。再生作物统一显示“生长中”。信件正常覆盖进度图标，不再整体隐藏入口。排除孵化器误读，保留松露油等真实加工。菜单失效与异常保留具体诊断，作物成熟和正常处理完成不逐项输出日志。

[b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*]麦穗图标位于技能与社交页签之间，使用原有菜单操作，无需另设快捷键。[/*]
[*]支持作物及再生、酒桶、压油机、熏鱼机等加工机器、树液采集器和陈酿桶。[/*]
[*]同产物、品质阶段、工作状态及完成日的内容跨地点合并；错时投料的机器显示最早批次及其占当日总数的数量，不取平均进度。[/*]
[*]使用游戏季节和日期；分钟加工显示具体时刻。作物日期以继续满足正常生长条件为前提。[/*]
[*]完成后保留已记录的日期并显示 100%；陈酿按下一品质阶段显示进度。[/*]
[*]使用原版菜单素材，支持滚轮、上下箭头与滑块拖动；长名称省略后可悬停查看全名。[/*]
[*]同一个安装包内置英文和简体中文，跟随游戏语言。[/*]
[/list]
[b]安装与更新[/b]
安装适合当前游戏版本的 SMAPI，将 ZIP 内的 ProductionProgress 文件夹解压至 Stardew Valley/Mods，通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，然后打开原菜单并选择麦穗页签。

更新前退出游戏，用新文件夹替换 Mods 中已有的 ProductionProgress 文件夹，不要同时保留两份。

[b]适用范围[/b]
0.1.9 已由作者在 Windows、Stardew Valley 1.6.8、SMAPI 4.0.8 下实测。0.1.16 作为正式版本发布，针对同一目标完成编译，80 项核心测试和 134 项菜单流程模拟检查通过；本轮改动尚未完成新一轮游戏内实测。Ultra Smooth 2.5.0 已做静态核验及菜单流程模拟，未在报告者完整 mod 组合中实测。更新游戏/SMAPI 版本及 macOS、Linux 未经大范围验证。必需前置为 SMAPI，不要求安装 Ultra Smooth、Content Patcher 或 Generic Mod Config Menu。

已实现多人主机与客户端同步，但多人和分屏尚未实机验证；使用多人视图需要主机和客户端均安装本 mod。替换同一套原版 UI 素材的美化包可以影响本页配色；完全替换主菜单或重排布局的 mod 可能需要单独适配。

名称后的数量代表这一批次中的作物或机器个数，不代表最终收获数量。果酒按游戏的机器分钟计时，因此可能在下午完成。首次遇到已经制作到一半、且无法还原完整周期的机器时，可能暂时没有百分比；没有可靠历史完成记录的旧产物日期留空，仍保留完成状态和 100%。本 mod 只观察生产状态，不加速、不自动收取、不改变产物。

[b]已知限制[/b]
首次安装时已在工作的重型采集器，仍有进行中条目缺失的反馈，尚未解决。使用黑色菜单背景时，打开信件后进度图标可能比相邻页签更暗。完全替换菜单的 mod 仍可能需要专门适配。

[b]源码与反馈[/b]
源码：[url=https://github.com/shy-ci/ProductionProgress]GitHub[/url]。反馈问题时请提供游戏、SMAPI 和 mod 版本，相关截图及 SMAPI 日志链接，并说明是否安装了其他菜单或机器加工类 mod。

[b]开发说明[/b]
代码、翻译及本页说明由 AI 按作者设计和反馈生成，作者完成游戏内测试。运行 mod 时不调用 AI 服务，发布截图来自真实游戏画面。
